derived_from: concept 'Field Guide Naturalism' + product mood (자연/신뢰/전문성/안정). NOT a prebuilt palette.

ontology_grounding.spectrum_bias: warm earth + deep green, low-to-mid chroma

dominant.intent: deep forest green — primary action / brand surface

neutral.intent: warm ink — primary text and line work

accent.intent: spore amber — single highlight / focus accent

wcag_notes: #2A2622 ink on #F4EEE2 paper ≈ 12.4:1 — AAA body text
#FBF7EE text on #2F4733 forest ≈ 9.6:1 — AAA on primary action
#A6402F danger on #FBF7EE ≈ 5.2:1 — AA for toxic warnings
#C8742B amber accent used for emphasis fills, not small body text
